# JmdictFurigana data notice

The generated offline reading shards in this directory were built from:

- Project: [JmdictFurigana](https://github.com/Doublevil/JmdictFurigana)
- Release: `2.3.1+2026-07-25`
- Asset: `JmdictFurigana.json.tar.gz`
- SHA-256: `fc02519134ba75389db1885127cd06b8beb3e4f1922c68c510b73f3b7175b01a`
- Release URL: <https://github.com/Doublevil/JmdictFurigana/releases/tag/2.3.1%2B2026-07-25>

JmdictFurigana is distributed under the Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike license, the same license as JMdict. The underlying
JMdict project is maintained by the Electronic Dictionary Research and
Development Group (EDRDG). Please retain this notice when redistributing the
generated data.

Only the JmdictFurigana asset backed by JMdict was used. The separate
`JmnedictFurigana` / proper-name dataset was not downloaded or used. The build
filters JMDict-backed entries only by whether their surface uses the 2,136
official Joyo Kanji characters (elementary school assignments plus the
remaining common-use characters); it does not classify or remove proper-name
entries that are present in JMdict. Kana and punctuation segments are kept.
The checked-in scope and its source are documented in `scripts/joyo-kanji.txt`
and `scripts/build-kanji-furigana.js`.

This notice covers generated data, not the Kuromoji/Kuroshiro files in the
other vendor notices.
